comment: DJFilter - the DJ mixer filter you ride by hand (Xone / DJM style) plus a kick kill. Three filter knobs, each off at 0: LP, HP and DJ (-100 LP ... 0 ... +100 HP, -3..+3 flat). LP amount = max(LP, DJ below 0), HP amount = max(HP, DJ above 0); a filter at 0 is skipped. Exponential sweep (LP 100 about 40 Hz, HP 100 about 10 kHz). Resonance rises as the filter closes; Reso sets the far-end amount. Kill = independent 24 dB/oct low cut. Slope 12/24, Glide smooths LP/HP/DJ, Level trim, Mix = DJ crossfade. Footswitch on/off is ramped over a few ms. Linked stereo.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack). 502 (484 clashed with the community effect Gyre; 482 and 483 are old aliases of other projects). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: LP
params.comment: Low-pass amount. 0 = off (skipped), 100 = closed down to about 40 Hz (exponential in frequency).

params.name: HP
params.comment: High-pass amount. 0 = off (skipped), 100 = closed up to about 10 kHz (exponential in frequency).

params.name: DJ
params.comment: One-knob DJ filter, shown -100 ... 0 ... +100 (value - 100). Left = low-pass, right = high-pass, -3..+3 flat. Combines with LP/HP: the more closed one wins.

params.name: Reso
params.comment: Resonance at the far end of the sweep. None when the filter is open, rising as it closes, capped well below self-oscillation (Q about 5 at 100). Default 30.

params.name: Kill
params.comment: Independent 24 dB/oct low cut. 0 = OFF, 1..281 = 20..300 Hz in 1 Hz steps. Default OFF.

params.name: Slope
params.comment: Filter slope for LP/HP: 0 = 12 dB/oct (gentle, warm), 1 = 24 dB/oct (hard DJ-mixer cut). Default 24. Kill is always 24.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: How fast LP/HP/DJ follow the knob. 0 = instant, 1..100 = 1 to 1000 ms on a log scale. Default 44 = about 20 ms.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Output trim in 0.5 dB steps: 0 = -12 dB, 24 = 0 dB, 36 = +6 dB. Default 0 dB.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50. Default 100.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate (the spec says about 6 with one filter on, about 9 with LP, HP and Kill all on; this is the all-on value): up to 6 state-variable stages per side, 3 mults each plus the output mix; coefficients once per block. Re-measure on the pedal.
